verdict.rationale: Qodo offers an in-product AI you can chat with directly inside pull requests, and you can have it apply a review fix for you. That means some tasks can be handed off, but the documented scope is narrow and centred on code review. A community comment mentions an agentic 'Qodo Command CLI' with permission toggles, but it is not documented in the pack. Missing for 10: evidence of open-ended task delegation beyond review findings, detail on what the PR chat assistant can actually do, hands-on corroboration of the assistant completing delegated tasks.
